The BFG — a 31.5 cm hand-launched foam chuck glider — as measured geometry run
through `AeroBuildup`.

- **`AeroBuildup` on 3D geometry**, with NeuralFoil section data.
- **Flat foam section**, 7.1% thick, approximated as a NACA 0007.
- **Measured geometry**; only the fin's aspect ratio is assumed.
- **Flying surfaces only** — no fuselage or boom.
- **Fixed speed per run**, since Re is ~2–4 × 10⁴ here.

## The model

Read straight from `_model.qmd` rather than copied, so this listing cannot drift
from what the entries actually run.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import pathlib
import re

source = pathlib.Path("chapters/01-aerobuildup-bfg/_model.qmd").read_text()
cell = re.search(r"^```\{python\}\n(.*?)^```", source, re.S | re.M).group(1)
code = "\n".join(l for l in cell.splitlines() if not l.startswith("#|"))

print('::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}')
print("## `_model.qmd`\n")
print("```python")
print(code.strip())
print("```")
print(":::")
```
